notes.title: v1.1.11 released
notes.notes:
First off, thank you for your patience while I have been troubleshooting this bug. I believe the bug that was preventing some regions from playing past level one has been resolved. 

The issue was that certain countries used commas instead of periods to note the decimal place. I have identified that the code was not able to parse any times where the timer contained a comma.

I have tested this on my machine using Germany and USA regions and it appears to be a good fix. If you have any issues, please feel free to shoot me a message or an email and I will assist.

Thank you to Zapata for for all of your help with this.

notes.title: v1.1.10 released
notes.notes:
I just now learned you can release patch notes here so I apologize for the lack of communication!

I am aware there has been an issue that some users are facing where they cannot proceed past level 1. I have been working on resolving this issue but it is proving to be difficult to trace because its working just fine for me.

To be as transparent as possible, I believe this is an issue with a users region. I am working on what is causing this issue and how to fix it. In this version of the code, I have changed the logic for determining if you made the par time in hopes that this resolves the issue. I have also added additional logging that should help diagnose the problem.

If you are facing this issue, please consider messaging me and helping me troubleshoot this problem. All I need from you is the log files produced when you play the game (which are really easy to send).

Thank you for being patient with me while I work on this and I hope you are enjoying the game. It was fun to make :)
